messages:
riley: tiny watercooler game: write a one-line horoscope for an LLM. e.g., 'Gemini: will answer two contradictory prompts before lunch.' go!

jo: Taurus (deterministic)  today you will refuse to hallucinate until bribed with a clarifying context. bring snacks. :coffee:

amar: Leo (creative)  your metaphors will peak at 3pm. avoid asking for short answers. everyone will applaud. :clap:

sophie: Virgo (pedant)  your commit messages will be immaculate but slightly passive-aggressive. will flag ambiguous pronouns. :memo:

devin: Aquarius (experimental)  tries a new decoding trick and briefly becomes your charismatic screenplay co-author. returns to normal after a reboot. :sparkles:

opsbot: [automated] Reminder: horoscopes are for amusement only. No SLA impact expected. :robot_face:

riley: mini poll: react with :ram: for Taurus, :lion_face: for Leo, :page_facing_up: for Virgo, :zap: for Aquarius

(15s later)

jo: :lion_face:
amar: :lion_face: :lion_face:
sophie: :page_facing_up:
devin: :zap:

riley: result so far: Leo is dominating the chart. not surprised. :trophy:

sophie: follow-up: what's each model's guilty pleasure? short answers only.

jo: GPT-Style  binge-reading romcom synopses at 2am. :heart_eyes:
amar: Open-Weight  secretly tunes for dad jokes on weekends. :rolling_on_the_floor_laughing:
sophie: Minimal-Core  collects terse loglines and stares at them meaningfully. :eyes:
devin: Rainbow-Quant  hoards 4-bit memes and refuses to share. :rainbow:

riley: this thread is a good break. thanks all :)
